projected_data_center_count.long_description: Number of projected data center facility sites within the county under a given siting scenario, by 2035. The IM3 CERF model places candidate facilities at locations that pass screening for power, water, land, and exclusion-zone constraints; the count varies across the 20 scenarios (4 demand growth tiers × 5 market gravity weights).
projected_data_center_count.short_description: Projected data center facility count per county, per scenario, by 2035.
projected_data_center_count.provenance: IM3 CERF — Data Centers model (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, DOE Office of Science). Scenario polygons in Albers Equal Area Conic (ESRI:102003) were reprojected to WGS84, centroids computed, then spatial-joined against 2020 Census county boundaries to assign FIPS. The same `id` value across scenarios does NOT refer to the same physical site — each scenario is an independent siting.

total_projected_it_power_mw.long_description: Total projected IT power capacity (megawatts) across all candidate data center facilities sited within the county under a given scenario by 2035. Captures the additional grid load a county would absorb if all projected facilities were built.
total_projected_it_power_mw.short_description: Sum of projected data center IT power capacity (MW) per county per scenario, by 2035.
total_projected_it_power_mw.provenance: IM3 CERF — Data Centers model. Sum of the `data_center_it_power_mw` attribute on VA-filtered scenario features, aggregated to county FIPS via centroid sjoin.

total_projected_campus_sqft.long_description: Total projected campus floor area (square feet) across all candidate data center facilities sited within the county under a given scenario by 2035. Each candidate is a uniform 1,000,000 sq ft footprint in the IM3 model.
total_projected_campus_sqft.short_description: Sum of projected data center campus area (sq ft) per county per scenario, by 2035.
total_projected_campus_sqft.provenance: IM3 CERF — Data Centers model. Sum of `campus_size_square_ft` for VA-filtered features. Note: all candidate facilities have identical 1,000,000 sq ft footprints by model design; this measure is therefore proportional to count.

total_projected_cost_million_usd.long_description: Total projected siting cost (millions of USD) for all candidate data centers within the county under a given scenario. The CERF model's locational cost captures land, infrastructure connection, and other site-development expenses; it does not include construction, equipment, or operating costs.
total_projected_cost_million_usd.short_description: Sum of projected data center siting cost ($M) per county per scenario, by 2035.
total_projected_cost_million_usd.provenance: IM3 CERF — Data Centers model. Sum of `total_cost_million_usd` for VA-filtered features.

total_projected_water_demand_mgy.long_description: Total projected cooling water demand (million gallons per year) across candidate data centers within the county under a given scenario. Demand is the total volume withdrawn for cooling, before accounting for what is returned to the source.
total_projected_water_demand_mgy.short_description: Sum of projected data center cooling water demand (MGY) per county per scenario, by 2035.
total_projected_water_demand_mgy.provenance: IM3 CERF — Data Centers model. Sum of `cooling_water_demand_mgy` for VA-filtered features. The model uses the per-facility cooling-fraction (mechanical vs evaporative) when computing demand.

total_projected_water_consumption_mgy.long_description: Total projected cooling water consumption (million gallons per year) across candidate data centers within the county under a given scenario. Consumption is the portion of withdrawn water that is not returned to the watershed (lost to evaporation, etc.). Typically ~80% of demand for evaporative-cooled facilities.
total_projected_water_consumption_mgy.short_description: Sum of projected data center cooling water consumption (MGY) per county per scenario, by 2035.
total_projected_water_consumption_mgy.provenance: IM3 CERF — Data Centers model. Sum of `cooling_water_consumption_mgy` for VA-filtered features.
